mechanism: Zoledronic acid can cause renal impairment and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia), which may alter apixaban clearance and increase bleeding risk, particularly in patients with compromised renal function.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; ensure adequate hydration during zoledronic acid infusion; assess bleeding risk if renal function declines; consider apixaban dose adjustment if creatinine clearance falls below 30 mL/min.
